sites.evidence_type: topology inference (C-terminal snorkel — no accessible terminus)
sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)
ordered surface loop (10 aa): pLDDT>=70, DSSP loop/turn, exposed junction residue (max RSA), indel-tolerant, 3D-clear of features

literature_notes: PANX1 has two extracellular loops (EL1: 62–106; EL2: 239–266) and both termini are intracellular (N-terminus IC1: 1–40; C-terminus IC3: 288–426). Every ledger line describes a tag on an intracellular face: L1/L3/L5/L6 report C-terminal EGFP fusions at residue 426 (IC3); L2 reports a C-terminal EGFP fusion after a caspase-site truncation ending at residue 378 (also IC3); L4 reports a Gly-Ser insertion at the N-terminus (IC1). None of the six lines places any tag in EL1 or EL2, and none qualifies as a snorkel construct. Because the ledger contains no published insertion on the extracellular face of PANX1, zero sites are proposed. The intracellular positions are recorded in other_positions.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal EGFP fusion (full-length Panx1-EGFP) confirmed at cell surface by biotinylation and WGA co-distribution; tag is intracellular (IC3, residues 288–426).
Panx1∆379-EGFP truncation construct fuses EGFP after residue 378 (Val, IC3); surface levels indistinguishable from full-length Panx1-EGFP by biotinylation; tag is intracellular.
Gly-Ser insertion at the N-terminus (Panx1+GS) yields larger currents than WT in HEK293 cells; N-terminus is intracellular (IC1, residues 1–40), so this is an intracellular tag.
